extra_egyeb:
The Client acknowledges and accepts that it may establish a business relationship with the make-up artists, hairdressers and other contributing professionals recommended or introduced by the Service Provider, or presented during the performance, exclusively through the Service Provider. The Client undertakes not to contact such professionals, either directly or indirectly, for the purpose of commissioning work, and not to conclude any independent agreement with them, without the prior written consent of the Service Provider.
This non-circumvention clause shall remain in force for the term of the cooperation between the Parties and for 12 months following its termination. In the event of a breach of this provision, the Client shall pay the Service Provider a contractual penalty equal to 100% of the total net service fee of the engagement affected by the circumvention, without prejudice to the Service Provider’s right to claim further damages.
